title: Kuala Lumpur to Penang: Family EV Road Trip Guide 2026
subtitle: The ultimate 4-day EV road trip from KL to Penang with kids — charging stops, kid-friendly attractions, and cost breakdown

route.kidActivities: Lost World of Tambun, Ipoh Old Town, Kin Loong Valley cave temples
Penang National Park, Escape Penang, Batu Ferringhi beach
Penang Hill funicular, Kek Lok Si temple, Entopia butterfly farm
Return drive with stop at Taiping Zoo or Lake Garden

bestFor: Families with kids aged 4-14 who want a mix of beach, nature, and city
tips: Book hotels with EV charging — Shangri-La Rasa Sayang and Eastern & Oriental Hotel both offer guest charging
Best time: December-February (dry season for Penang beach days)
Kids will love the Penang Hill train — book online to skip queues
Pack swimsuits in the trunk — Lost World of Tambun water park is an unplanned stop waiting to happen
Download Gentari Go and ChargeSini apps before departure for live charger status
